title: API Client Configuration Generator
description: Generate a centralized API client configuration at lib/client/config.ts with ApiClient initialization, interceptor examples, and utility re-exports. Auto-invoked by action generator on first use.

projectName.description: Target project name where config will be generated at src/lib/client/config.ts. Auto-creates feature if not found.

clientPackage.description: API client package to import from. Use @next-feature/client (default) or custom package like @myorg/api-client

baseUrl.description: Base URL for API requests. Use environment variable reference (default: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) or hardcoded URL

includeInterceptors.description: Include example request/response interceptor setup for adding authentication headers, logging, and custom error handling

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)
